name: Bajaj Electricals Limited
summary: Bajaj Electricals Limited provides consumer products and lighting solutions in India. It offers ceiling, table, pedestal, wall, personal, tower, lifestyle, and domestic exhaust fans; ceiling lights, smart products, inverter lights, lamps, battens, decorative lights, accessories, outdoor lights, and portable lights; and indoor and outdoor lighting products.
